g.card: Sinthani masiwichi a njanji ndipo tsogolerani ngolo iliyonse ya mgodi kupita pa potulukira pa mtundu wake.
g.genre: Masewera a puzzle a njanji ndi ngolo za mgodi
g.desc: Gnome des Cavernes Enchantées: ma puzzle a njanji 90 m’mapanga a kristalo 6. Sinthani masiwichi ndipo tsogolerani ngolo iliyonse kupita pa potulukira pa mtundu wake.
g.h2: Puzzle ya njanji m’mapanga a kamunthu kakang’ono
g.p1: Ngolo zimatuluka mumsewu wa pansi ndi kugudubuzika zokha. Sinthani masiwichi kuti iliyonse ifike pa potulukira pa mtundu wake popanda kugundana.
g.p2: Magawo 90 m’mapanga 6: ma leva, milatho yozungulira, ayezi, madzi okwera ndi chiphalaphala. Pezani nyenyezi 3 ndi masunthidwe ochepa, ndipo kamunthu kakang’ono kamakuthandizani mukakakamira.
l.card: Zunguzani magalasi, tsogolerani kuwala ndipo yatsaninso zipinda 150 za nyumba yachifumu.
l.genre: Masewera a puzzle a magalasi ndi kuwala
l.desc: Le Château des Lumières: zunguzani magalasi ndipo tsogolerani kuwala ku makristalo m’magawo 150 ndi maiko 6 ojambulidwa.
l.h2: Puzzle ya kuwala m’nyumba yachifumu yamatsenga
l.p1: Nyumba yachifumu yazima. Zunguzani magalasi ndi zipinda kuti mutsogolere kuwala ku makristalo: onse akawala, chitseko chagolide chimatseguka.
l.p2: Magawo 150 m’maiko 6: mitundu yosakaniza, magalasi amitundu, ma prism, zifaniziro ndi ma giya. Malangizo ndi nyenyezi 3 pa gawo lililonse kwa anzeru kwambiri.
l.f2: Magalasi, ma prism, magalasi amitundu ndi ma giya
d.card: Thamangani, ulukani ndipo pumirani moto m’maufumu 7 amatsenga ndi mabwana awo 7.
d.desc: Le Petit Dragon: masewera a pulatifomu a 2D ojambulidwa ndi manja. Dutsani maufumu 7, magawo 63 ndi mabwana 7 kuti muthamangitse Mfumu ya Mithunzi.
d.p1: Sewerani ngati chinjoka chaching’ono chobiriwira cholimba mtima. Thamangani, dumphani, yandamani mumlengalenga ndipo pumirani moto kuti muthamangitse Mfumu ya Mithunzi.
d.p2: Maufumu 7, magawo 63 ndi mabwana 7, aliyense ali ndi chinyengo chake. Sonkhanitsani makristalo ndipo pezani mpaka nyenyezi 3 pa gawo lililonse.
d.f2: Mabwana 7 oti mugonjetse, aliyense ndi chinyengo chake
t.card: Dulani, zunguzani ndi kuyika mitambo kuti mutsegulire telala wamng’ono njira.
t.genre: Masewera a puzzle a mitambo ndi mawonekedwe
t.desc: Le Tailleur de Nuages: ma puzzle 240 m’madera 12 a kumwamba. Dulani, zunguzani ndi kuyika mitambo kuti mutsegule njira.
t.p1: Zilumba zikuyandama kumwamba ndipo chitseko chamatsenga chikudikirira. Dulani mitambo, izunguzeni ndi kuiyika kuti mumange njira ya telala wamng’ono.
t.p2: Magawo 240 m’madera 12 ojambulidwa, popanda wotchi. Pezani nyenyezi 3, tsegulani mabokosi ndipo sonkhanitsani mitambo.
w.card: Ikani ma giya, pititsani mphamvu ndipo dzutsani ufumu womwe uli mtulo.
w.genre: Masewera a puzzle a ma giya
w.desc: Les Rouages Enchantés: ma puzzle a makina 150 m’maiko a nthano 6. Ikani ma giya ndipo pititsani mphamvu kuti makina ayambirenso.
w.h2: Masewera a puzzle okhala ndi ma giya enieni
w.p1: Temberero lazizira ufumu. Ikani ma giya pamalo oyenera kuti mupititse mphamvu ya injini yamatsenga ndipo makina agwirenso ntchito.
w.p2: Magawo 150 m’maiko 6: ma rune, ma leva, kuwala kwa kristalo ndi wotchi ya mchenga. Pezani nyenyezi 3 ndipo onani mamapu akubwezeretsa mitundu yawo.
u.card: Ikani mabuloko a ma rune ogwa ndipo phatikizani ma rune a mtundu umodzi kuti asowe.
u.genre: Masewera a puzzle a mabuloko ogwa
u.tag: Phatikizani ma rune, lumikizani ma combo.
u.desc: Royaume des Runes: ikani mabuloko a ma rune ogwa, phatikizani mitundu ndipo lumikizani ma combo m’magawo 180 ndi madera 6.
u.h2: Mabuloko a ma rune ndi ma combo
u.p1: Mabuloko a ma rune amagwera pa bolodi. Asunthireni ndi kuwazunguza kuti muphatikize ma rune a mtundu umodzi: amasowa ndipo chilichonse chimagwera pansi.
u.p2: Magawo 180 m’madera 6, kuchokera ku Nsanja ya Wamatsenga mpaka ku Linga la Kumwamba. Lumikizani ma combo kuti mupeze nyenyezi 3.
n.card: Tsogolerani chinjoka, idyani ma rune ndipo kulani osaluma mchira wanu.
n.desc: Serpent des Runes: masewera a njoka okhala ndi chinjoka. Idyani ma rune, pewani zopinga ndipo gonjetsani alonda 6 m’magawo 120.
n.h2: Masewera a njoka okhala ndi chinjoka
n.p1: Chinjoka sichiima konse. Swipani kuti muchitembenuze, idyani ma rune kuti mukule ndipo pewani makoma ndi thupi lanu.
n.p2: Magawo 120 m’madera 6, iliyonse imayang’aniridwa ndi bwana. Ma rune amatsenga amachedwetsa nthawi, amakusandutsani mzimu kapena amakutetezani.
n.f2: Ma rune amatsenga okhala ndi mphamvu zosiyanasiyana
